sweep.mode: capstone CS_MODE_32 disasm_lite, 64KB chunks, detail=False, no whole-listing retention

iid_census.rule: 4-byte-aligned A in .rdata/.data (file-backed bytes only) with dword[1]==0, (dword[2]&0xFFFF)==0x00C0, dword[3]==0x46000000

q1.method: bytes 68+LE32(0x7f7c80) in .text; accept only if addr is a decoded instruction start from the chunked linear sweep, the decoded mnemonic is push, op_str==0x7f7c80, instruction size==5, i.e. bytes[1:5] IS the imm32 operand
q1.criterion_note: each criterion is used both for start assignment and for extent (end=next boundary under the SAME criterion), so a site always lies inside its own function by construction
